tax.text: Foushee supports higher taxes on corporations and high-income earners alongside expanded tax credits for health care, housing, and child care.
tax.quote: Foushee supports a progressive tax system that provides relief for middle and low-income families while increasing taxes on large corporations and high-income earners.

wages.text: Foushee supports raising the federal minimum wage and strengthening unions.
wages.quote: an advocate for legislation that will raise the federal minimum wage and ease access to affordable credit for first-time homeowners and small business owners.

trade.text: Foushee says she is opposing the Trump administration's tariffs as part of her effort to lower consumer costs.
trade.quote: In Congress, she is standing up to Trump’s tariffs and taking on corporate price gouging that drives up costs.

debt.text: Foushee pledges to oppose cuts to Social Security and Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: She will never let Trump and Republicans cut seniors’ benefits.

housing.text: Foushee praised a federal plan to increase housing supply and encourage states and municipalities to change zoning and land-use regulations.
housing.quote: increase the supply of housing, incentivizes states and municipalities to change their zoning and land-use regulations

schools.text: Foushee cosponsored legislation to repeal the federal tax credit for donations supporting private-school scholarships.
schools.quote: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to repeal the tax credit for contributions of individuals to scholarship granting organizations, and for other purposes.

safety.text: Foushee called for increased funding for community-based violence-intervention programs in streets, hospitals, and schools.
safety.quote: Community-based violence intervention programs, on the streets, in hospitals, and in schools, are critical to ending gun violence and should be better funded.

immigration.text: Foushee supports a pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients and Dreamers and reforms to the visa system.
immigration.quote: I believe we must ease the pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients and Dreamers, update our antiquated visa lottery structure

guns.text: Foushee supports an assault-weapons ban, universal background checks, safe-storage requirements, and limits on high-capacity magazines.
guns.quote: to reinstate the federal assault weapons ban and advance important gun safety measures such as enforcing background checks on gun sales.

abortion.text: Foushee says she is committed to restoring abortion rights and protecting personal reproductive decisions.
abortion.quote: I am committed to restoring the fundamental right to an abortion and making sure everyone has the freedom to make the best and safest decision

gender.text: Foushee voted against a bill that would have required federally funded school athletics to recognize sex solely from reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: As a North Carolina senator, Foushee was a primary sponsor of legislation to legalize and regulate adult cannabis.
cannabis.quote: The use of cannabis should be legal for persons 21 years of age or older and

health.text: Foushee calls health care a human right and is an original cosponsor of Medicare for All legislation.
health.quote: Healthcare is a human right, but far too many people in our country are victims of a broken healthcare system and are unable to afford necessary care.

energy.text: Foushee supports moving away from fossil fuels, meeting climate goals, and the Green New Deal.
energy.quote: move the United States away from our dependence on fossil fuels while meeting our climate goals and achieving true energy independence.

tax.text: He says departmental budget cuts and oversight savings should reduce taxes.
tax.quote: The savings will reduce taxes, and the deficit. Our grandchildren will thank us!

wages.text: He opposes state government determining what employers must pay.
wages.quote: For someone in Raleigh to tell employers in Murphy or Manteo or Morrisville what to pay their employees is overreach.

debt.text: He says departmental savings should be used to reduce the federal deficit.
debt.quote: The savings will reduce taxes, and the deficit. Our grandchildren will thank us!

housing.text: He supports loosening zoning restrictions to expand lower-cost housing choices.
housing.quote: Zoning should not get in the way of housing choices.

schools.text: He supports fully funding scholarships that families can use for private schools.
schools.quote: Expand and fully fund the North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship program, allowing greater access for all families, including those who lack the financial means to enroll their students in a private school.

immigration.text: Meilleur conditionally supports federal-local immigration enforcement when officials will not hand over people guilty of serious crimes after their sentences.
immigration.quote: Only if local officials are not cooperating on handing over those guilty of serious crimes, after time is served.

guns.text: He supports higher age limits and stronger background checks for more powerful firearms.
guns.quote: More powerful weapons should require higher age limits and stronger background checks.

abortion.text: He argues that arbitrary gestational benchmarks should not determine abortion law and opposes arbitrary government power over people's bodies.
abortion.quote: Arbitrary benchmarks are a poor basis for legislation.

cannabis.text: He supports allowing cannabis production and regulating legal cannabis activity.
cannabis.quote: Government needs to get out of the way of production, and profit from reasonable regulation of other cannabis activity, as other states do.

health.text: He advocates a market-driven health-care system modeled on Singapore.
health.quote: We can emulate Singapore’s market-driven health care system and stop feeding Big Pharma, and making millionaires out of fraudsters.

voting.text: He supports retaining early voting, same-day registration, and mail voting.
voting.quote: The 2020 schedule for early voting, same day registration, and mail-in voting should remain.

tax.text: Ganorkar says working families should keep more of their earnings and proposes eliminating several federal taxes.
tax.quote: If you believe working families should keep more of their hard-earned money, I’m your candidate. Common sense tells us higher taxes drive jobs and businesses away—leaving fewer opportunities and greater hardship behind.

trade.text: Ganorkar opposes tariffs and protectionism because he says their costs fall on consumers.
trade.quote: I am not in favor of tariffs at all. I was never in favor of tariffs. I am not in favor of protectionism either.

housing.text: Ganorkar proposes reducing construction regulations and increasing the housing supply and homeownership opportunities.
housing.quote: Reduce unnecessary regulations and costs that inflate home construction prices. Promote policies that increase housing supply and homeownership opportunities.

schools.text: Ganorkar supports privatization, school vouchers, and expanded private and vocational schooling.
schools.quote: I believe expanding school choice and privatizing education would create more opportunities for students by encouraging schools that cater to different talents, career paths, and learning styles instead of a one-size-fits-all system.

safety.text: Ganorkar strongly opposed redirecting police funding to community programs.
safety.quote:
I support redirecting funds from police departments to community programs.

Strongly Disagree

immigration.text: Ganorkar combines rule-of-law and assimilation requirements with a proposed legal, vetted seasonal-worker pathway.
immigration.quote: By vetting seasonal workers through U.S. embassies, businesses can fill temporary labor needs legally, temp-immigrant workers are protected from exploitation, and participants return to their home countries once the work is complete.

guns.text: Ganorkar calls for nationwide constitutional carry and opposes restrictions on armed, law-abiding citizens.
guns.quote: Common sense tells us when criminals and unstable individuals are armed, law-abiding citizens must have the right to protect themselves — without unnecessary restrictions.

abortion.text: Ganorkar personally opposes abortion but says families and medical professionals should decide in cases of rape, incest, or danger to the mother's life.
abortion.quote: My faith discourages abortion, and personally I do not support it; however, in tragic cases such as rape, incest, or when a mother’s life is at risk, I believe these decisions should remain within the family, guided by medical professionals.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Ganorkar strongly agreed that biological males should be excluded from women's sports and designated women's spaces.
gender.quote:
Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

Strongly Agree

health.text: Ganorkar proposes publicly supplied vouchers for purchasing private insurance, interstate competition, and reduced reliance on government health programs.
health.quote: Americans should be able to purchase insurance from anywhere in the country to increase competition and lower costs.

energy.text: Ganorkar proposes eliminating energy taxes to reduce living costs.
energy.quote: Eliminate taxes on energy and food to bring down costs of living.

voting.text: Ganorkar strongly opposed allowing people to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote:
People should be able to vote without photo identification.

Strongly Disagree
